units.title: Verify: Frame classes, four-state Button and framed screen components render

tests.name: tests/frameKit.test.tsx > frame kit > frame classes use border-image and pixelated
tests.title: frame classes use border-image and pixelated
tests.scenario: Given the frame kit generator exported from the frame sources, when frameComponentClasses is called, then each sf-frame class is pixelated with a border-image from its FRAME_KIT file and slice, and the sf-btn states carry distinct border-image values.
tests.detail: Step 1: sf-frame-{bar,panel,plaque,parchment,slot} rules have imageRendering 'pixelated' and borderImage containing the FRAME_KIT file name and slice; .sf-btn, .sf-btn:disabled, [data-state='hover'], [data-state='pressed'] exist with four distinct borderImage values.

tests.name: tests/frameKit.test.tsx > frame kit > button shows four states
tests.title: button shows four states
tests.scenario: Given a frame Button rendered in each of the four states (normal, hover, pressed, disabled), when it is rendered, then each has the sf-btn class and matching data-state, the disabled one is disabled, and a Frame of kind panel carries sf-frame-panel.
tests.detail: Step 2: Button variant=frame renders sf-btn with data-state for normal/hover/pressed/disabled; only disabled has the disabled attribute; Frame kind=panel renders class sf-frame-panel.

tests.name: tests/frameKit.test.tsx > frame kit > game screen components apply the kit
tests.title: game screen components apply the kit
tests.scenario: Given GameLayout, HeaderOverlay (worldTitle 'W', no round) and StoryPanel (one inventory item, Guide dialogue node) rendered with the kit props, when they are rendered, then the aside is sf-frame-panel, the header is sf-frame-bar with an sf-btn Settings button, the inventory item is sf-frame-slot, and the Dialogue region is sf-frame-parchment.
tests.detail: Step 3: aside.sf-frame-panel in GameLayout; header.sf-frame-bar and Settings button.sf-btn in HeaderOverlay; listitem.sf-frame-slot and region 'Dialogue' sf-frame-parchment in StoryPanel. Components were not mocked; the uiStore was reset via setState.
